classification.difficultyReason: Interpret the stated collinear point order and apply a straight-angle supplement without a supplied diagram.

content.prompt: Suppose $A$, $B$ and $C$ are three points on a line, in that order. If $\angle ABX=40^\circ$, then find $\angle CBX$.

answer.worked:
Angles on straight line $ABC$ sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle ABX+\angle CBX&=180^\circ\\40^\circ+\angle CBX&=180^\circ\\\angle CBX&=140^\circ\end{align*}$$
